entries.title: Choose GPT-6 Luna Decisions for Firstmate's quick decisions
entries.body: Settings → Intelligence → Models → Decisions now lists OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions among the models your OpenRouter sign-in offers. It works like the others there: it needs no extra key, and when it cannot answer, Firstmate decides the usual way.
entries.noPicture: The new choice appears as one more row in an existing list.
